title: New to Claude? Set It Up Right in 10 Minutes (Connectors Explained)

segments.title: Claude, set up right, in 10 minutes
bullets: Sign up free
Tell it who you are, once
Connect your tools safely
segments.img: A small shop owner at a counter with a laptop, a friendly round robot assistant beside them, and a big clock showing ten minutes. Flat vector illustration, bright friendly colors (teal, orange, purple, yellow, sky blue) on a clean light background, simple shapes, modern, no text, no logos.
segments.say: In the next few minutes you'll set up Claude the right way: sign up free, tell it who you are once so every answer fits your business, and connect it to your tools safely. Let's start with step one.

segments.title: Sign up: the free plan is enough
bullets: Go to claude.ai or get the Claude app
Sign up with your email or Google account
Start on the free plan
segments.say: Step one. Go to claude dot A I on your computer, or get the Claude app on your phone. Sign up with your email or your Google account. Start on the free plan. It's enough to learn everything on this channel, and you can upgrade later if you hit the limits.

segments.title: Tell it who you are, once
bullets: Open Settings and find your preferences
Your business, your customers, your tone
Now you don't repeat it in every chat

chat.user: I own a [furniture store] in [Virginia] with [8 employees]. My customers are [families furnishing a first home]. Write in a friendly, plain tone. Keep answers short and give me steps.
chat.ai: (Saved as your preferences. Claude uses this in future chats.)

segments.say: Step two is the one most people skip. Open Settings and look for your preferences, the place where you tell Claude about yourself. Write two or three sentences: what your business is, who your customers are, and the tone you like. Now you don't have to repeat it in every chat.

segments.title: Give it one real job today
bullets: Pick something from today's to-do list
Say who, what, details, format
Ask it to fix what you don't like

chat.user: Write a text to my team: we open at 9 on Saturday for the holiday sale, everyone in by 8:30, lunch is on me. Friendly, under 50 words.
chat.ai: (Example answer) Team, big day Saturday! Doors open at 9 for the holiday sale, so please be in by 8:30. Lunch is on me. Let's make it a great one!

segments.say: Step three. Give it one real job from today's list, not a test question. Say who it's for, what you need, the details, and the format. If the answer isn't right, don't start over. Just tell it what to change.

segments.title: Use a Project for your store
bullets: One place for your store's files
Upload price lists and policies
Claude answers from your documents
segments.say: Step four. Look for Projects. A project is one place for your store's files and instructions. Upload things like your return policy or price list, and Claude can answer from your own documents instead of guessing. What you can do here depends on your plan.

segments.title: What is a connector?
bullets: A safe link between Claude and a tool
Email, calendar, files and more
It only looks when you ask
segments.img: A friendly round robot assistant in the middle connected by glowing lines to an envelope, a calendar and a folder. Flat vector illustration, bright friendly colors (teal, orange, purple, yellow, sky blue) on a clean light background, simple shapes, modern, no text, no logos.
segments.say: Now, connectors. A connector is a link between Claude and a tool you already use, like your email, your calendar or your files. Once it's connected, you can say: look at my calendar and plan my week. You'll find them in Settings, under Connectors. Which ones you get depends on your plan.

segments.title: 3 rules before you connect anything
bullets: Connect only what you need
Read what it asks permission for
You can disconnect any time
segments.say: Three safety rules before you connect anything. One, connect only what you need. Two, read what it asks permission for before you click allow. Three, remember you can disconnect any time in Settings. And never paste passwords or customer card numbers into any A I tool.

segments.title: Your first connector prompt
bullets: Works after you connect a calendar
Ask for a draft, then review it
You press send, not the AI

chat.user: Look at my calendar for next week. List my busiest days and draft a short email to my team with the schedule. Don't send anything.
chat.ai: (Example answer) Your busiest days are Tuesday and Friday. Here's a draft email for your team to review...

segments.say: Here's a first connector prompt to try. Ask Claude to look at next week's calendar, list your busiest days, and draft an email to your team. Notice the last line: don't send anything. You review it, and you press send.

segments.title: Subscribe: next is a week of staff emails in 15 minutes
bullets: The setup checklist is in the description
We're trying to reach 100 subscribers by Dec 31
segments.say: The full setup checklist is in the description. Next lesson, we write a whole week of staff emails in fifteen minutes. We're a small channel trying to reach a hundred subscribers by December thirty first, so if this helped, subscribe and you won't miss it.
